title: Spring AOP Fundamentals
description: Understand cross-cutting concerns and general AOP theory, then apply Spring's proxy-based AOP safely — writing aspects, pointcuts, and advice while recognizing how framework features like @Transactional rely on the same interception mechanism.

nodes.description: Understand why cross-cutting concerns like logging and auditing scatter and tangle code, then learn the core AOP vocabulary — aspect, join point, pointcut, advice, target, proxy, and weaving — that names the problem and its solution.
